components.name: Site footer
components.description: A body-level footer on home, content and 404 pages, with a named return-home navigation independent of optional metadata or header links.
components.html: Back to the home page

rules.name: Document landmarks and headings
rules.body: Home, content and 404 pages have a header, navigation, main and site footer. Effective Markdown and raw HTML headings obey one H1 and no skipped levels. A leading home H1 merges into the hero with its id; an unmerged author H1 is a located error.
